reviews.title: Very snappy ddr5 ram
reviews.comment: Very fast ddr5 ram i paired it with i5 13400 cpu, rtx 3050 6gb model, 2tb gen 4 nvme and a gigabyte b760m ax motherboard couldn't be happier everything is so quick and snappy. Gaming at between 1080p and 1440p is a breeze now. Really loving this ram.
